name: Wild Cannon Blow
doc: Wild Cannon Blow (enemy attack 70, the Galbadian soldiers' SAM08G): four Cannon Blow shots from its two muzzles in turn - each a fire ball shot on a curve to near the targets' centre with its flash, burst, ring and two fire trails, then an impact and its ring, smoke at every target, the camera shake; the two sounds; the damage to every target at tick 36. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag156_wild_cannon_blow.cpp) run on the program's memory (its particle tables, curves and queues in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The master's timeline: the two sounds, the shots, the damage to every target, its end; the shots' timing and aim, the camera shake; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Flash
parts.doc: A spinning flash mesh at the muzzle as each shot leaves, growing and fading

parts.title: Burst
parts.doc: Fire particles bursting out of the muzzle along the shot, slowing

parts.title: Ring
parts.doc: A ring mesh on the floor under the muzzle, fading

parts.title: Fire ball
parts.doc: The fire ball flying along the shot's curve, slowing

parts.title: Trails
parts.doc: Two fire trails the ball leaves along its curve (the second one jittered), growing

parts.title: Impact
parts.doc: The impact mesh and its ring at the landing point, spinning, growing, fading

parts.title: Target smoke
parts.doc: Smoke particles at every target's body after each impact
